description: This script automates the process of managing GitHub security advisories related to vulnerability patches. It parses command-line arguments, interacts with the GitHub CLI ('gh'), retrieves repository information, reads a description file, constructs a payload for security advisory updates, and applies these updates via GitHub API calls. The script is tailored specifically for managing advisories for the 'openclaw' package in an npm ecosystem context.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for running the script to stderr.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message to stderr and terminates the process with exit code 1.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a key-value object, validating presence and format.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Executes the GitHub CLI ('gh') with specified arguments, returning stdout, or fails on error.

methods.name: deriveRepoFromOrigin
methods.description: Extracts the GitHub repository identifier from the 'origin' remote URL.

methods.name: parseGhsaId
methods.description: Extracts and validates the GHSA ID from input strings.

methods.name: writeTempJson
methods.description: Creates a temporary JSON file with provided data, returning its path.
